for i in $(seq 1 11); do

  bytes=$(python3 -c "import shutil; print(shutil.disk_usage('.').free)")
  echo "$ts,$bytes" >> "$csv"
  if [ "$i" -lt 11 ]; then sleep 57; fi
done
end_epoch=$(date -u +%s)
echo "---elapsed_seconds---"
echo $((end_epoch - start_epoch))
echo "---csv---"
cat "$csv"
